name: zvideo_dd_create_directdraw2_for_selected_device
description: zVideo_dd::CreateDirectDraw2ForSelectedDevice creates a DirectDraw provider for the selected device, queries IDirectDraw2, stores it globally, and releases the temporary provider on success.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /MD /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?CreateDirectDraw2ForSelectedDevice@zVideo_dd@@YAHXZ passes with zero unmasked mismatches after 32 relocation-masked bytes and 11 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a8800 validates DirectDrawCreate(g_zVideo_pSelectedHwApiDeviceRecord->pDirectDrawGuid, &pDirectDraw1, 0), ReportError line 0x3c4 on create failure, IDirectDraw::QueryInterface(IID_IDirectDraw2, &g_zVideo_pDirectDraw2), ReportError line 0x3cb on query failure, temporary IDirectDraw::Release only after successful QueryInterface, and return zero on success.

The native smoke patches DDRAW.dll!DirectDrawCreate, verifies the success path arguments, QueryInterface IID/out pointer, global IDirectDraw2 storage, and temporary provider Release, then verifies create-failure and query-failure paths do not release the temporary provider or overwrite the existing global.
